narrative:
## Handover Summary — Estate & Investment

Programme phasing and payback assumptions are confirmed by workstream and region.

## Key Decisions
• Technology modernisation releases re-phased to lift on-budget delivery
• Convenience England milestones accelerated on secured consents
• Build-to-Rent kept on its long-payback track, outside the retail estate envelope

## Recommendation for Rolling Forecast Phase
Carry the depreciation phasing and new-space sales curves into the 13-week scenarios.

signals.title: GBP 800M retail estate transformation
signals.excerpt: 28 Waitrose refurbishments and 3 new convenience shops, John Lewis shop refresh and supply chain automation over the plan period.

signals.title: Meter Programme — 5 legacy data platforms into Snowflake
signals.excerpt: Consolidating BigQuery, Teradata, SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL estates onto Snowflake. Oracle Finance (CDC), Kooper and DIDOS already landed but under-used by Finance.
